review.why: Builds verified, scored prospect lists across four motions (SaaS, B2B, local, demand-signal) with qualification evidence and compliance guardrails.
review.summary: Picks a branch, then runs five phases: define the ICP, discover candidates, qualify each with evidence and a confidence level, score Hot to Skip, and output a lead sheet with top targets. Eight compliance rules ban bulk scraping, bypassing logins and unprovenanced data. Emails are verified before use and each contact keeps its source and date.
strengths: Every qualification needs a source link and an honest confidence level
Compliance rules come first: no scraping at scale, no sensitive-trait targeting
Hot needs a real buying signal, not just a fit
cautions: Works best with paid data tools; browser-only research is slower
Privacy and consent law depends on country: legal review for regulated outreach
Eleven reference files are not read here
